events.verdict: Quickley (TOR) and Ball (CHA) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Quickley (TOR) and Diabate (CHA) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Poeltl (TOR) brushes Ball's (CHA) arm and the contact at the end of the drive is marginal.
Sexton (CHA) moves alongside Barrett's (TOR) path and maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt.
Diabate (CHA) cleanly blocks Barrett's (TOR) shot attempt before the ball touches the backboard.
Poeltl (TOR) cleanly dislodges the ball from Bridges (CHA).
Diabate (CHA) fails to fully clear the lane and is in the paint for longer than three seconds.
Poeltl (TOR) rests his arms on Diabate's (CHA) upper body and Poeltl release away from Diabate to pursue the long rebound.
Ball (CHA) brings his hand toward the ball and the follow-through contact with Quickley's (TOR) upper body is marginal.
Knueppel (CHA) legally contests Ingram's (TOR) jump shot attempt.

Play is stopped to confirm with the Replay Center that Ingram's (TOR) shot attempt at Q4 1:06 touched the rim.  After  communicating with the Replay Center, it was determined that Ingram's shot attempt did make contact with the rim and the shot clock was correctly reset to 14 seconds following Barnes' (TOR) offensive rebound.
Barnes (TOR) cleanly dislodges the ball from Diabate (CHA).
Barnes (TOR) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Hornets.
Barnes (TOR) and Knueppel (CHA) briefly engage and disengage as they navigate the screen.
Quickley (TOR) moves alongside Ball's (CHA) path and maintains a legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt.
Kalkbrenner (CHA) loses control of the rebound on his own prior to any contact from Quickley (TOR), which is deemed marginal.
Ingram (TOR) steps on the baseline out of bounds while he is in possession of the ball.
Poeltl (TOR) briefly grasps Kalkbrenner's (CHA) left arm and releases him as he jumps to contest the shot at the basket.
Kalkbrenner (CHA) legally contests Barrett's (TOR) layup attempt.
Ball (CHA) momentarily places his hand on Quickley's (TOR) front during the drive, and the contact is marginal.
Ingram (TOR) cleanly blocks Kalkbrenner's (CHA) shot at the basket.
Kalkbrenner's (CHA) left hand remains in contact with the ball and he has not yet released his shot attempt when he pulls the rim from its natural resting place.
Poeltl (TOR) cleanly dislodges the ball from Kalkbrenner (CHA).
Poeltl (TOR) is the last player to touch it before it goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to the Hornets.
Barrett (TOR) legally contests Bridges' (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Poeltl (TOR) and James (CHA) briefly engage and disengage as they pursue the rebound.

Barnes (TOR) cleanly blocks Sexton's (CHA) shot at the basket.  The crew communicates with the Replay Center for a potential clock malfunction.  After communicating with the Replay Center, it was confirmed the game clock expired before the ball went out of bounds, and the game is over.
